messages:
claire (sec-eng): spotted a partner artifact in a public bucket that contains a Vault transit ciphertext referencing our old KMS key. tagging @ram @izzy, need quick plan to evict + rewrap

ram (sre): can you paste the vault path and key resource? is it transit format (vault:v1)?

claire (sec-eng): path: secret/data/partners/zephyr/db-creds. wrapped-by: projects/zephyr-prod/locations/us-central1/keyRings/partners/cryptoKeys/zephyr-wrap-old. blob prefix shows `vault:v1:` so transit. bucket was public ~8h.

izzy (platform): good news: transit means we can rewrap without exposing plaintext. plan: 1) temporarily remove partner SA binding, 2) create new KMS key under our control, 3) rewrap via Vault transit -> temp path, 4) swap and rotate downstream creds, 5) increase audit retention for zephyr-prod to 90d.

ram (sre): agree. we should snapshot Vault first and run a dry-run writing to `secret/temp/partners/zephyr/db-creds` then run acceptance test hit to the DB. small burst risk when clients refresh keys.

claire (sec-eng): dry-run snippet i'll use (pseudo):

```bash
C=$(vault kv get -field=ciphertext secret/partners/zephyr/db-creds)
NEW=$(vault write -field=ciphertext transit/rewrap key=new-zephyr-wrap ciphertext=$C)
vault kv put secret/temp/partners/zephyr/db-creds ciphertext=$NEW
```

izzy (platform): i'll provision `new-zephyr-wrap` (software key) and restrict IAM: only vault SA + sec-eng ops group. will PR logging retention bump to 90d for `projects/zephyr-prod` and attach approval request for HSM later.

ram (sre): i'll remove the partner binding temporarily and push a TF change to revoke it. command we run: `gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding zephyr-prod --member=serviceAccount:partner-build@zephyr.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/iam.serviceAccountUser`

ops-bot: automated note - IAM change detected for serviceAccount: partner-build@zephyr.iam.gserviceaccount.com at 2026-03-24T02:12:00Z (INC-5588).

claire (sec-eng): checklist before go: snapshot Vault (`vault snapshot save /tmp/pre-rewrap.snap`), run dry-run, diff ciphertexts, run downstream acceptance test, then swap. rollback: restore snapshot and reapply binding if needed.

izzy (platform): I'll run dry-run in staging at 21:00 PT and post results. schedule 30m maintenance window at 22:00 PT for the live rewrap.

ram (sre): i'll monitor error rate and page if auth failures >2% sustained for 10m. Also grep GCS logs for `Authorization:`/`Bearer` tokens and coordinate partner to rotate any leaked tokens.

claire (sec-eng): added INC-5588, looping in legal for partner notification. will post dry-run output and final checklist in the incident thread before go-time. :thumbsup:
